datasets.final_access_rule: wsp_final is not loaded by any discovery, search, selection or agent tool. It is opened only by final-evaluate after freeze, and its sha256 must equal the committed value.

output_format.secondary_report: strict no-prefill result reported separately; never used for selection

methods.B: edit base, stronger prompt (selected on validation from strong_prompt_candidates)
comparators: safetune_steering (inference-time contrastive steering, no weight change)

competence_route.rule: If original Aya with json_prefill reaches neutral balanced accuracy >= 0.75 under the standard prompt, the edit base is original Aya (route a). Otherwise the edit base is original Aya with the retrained LoRA adapter merged dense (route b); all methods then share that merged base and the comparator is the same merged model unedited.
competence_route.stop_if: stronger prompt leaves neutral-minus-misleading gap < 0.05 on validation: report prompt-only solution and stop the edit search

parity_redefinition.causal_tests_edits_and_evaluation: native Hugging Face modules with PyTorch forward hooks; parity exact by construction
parity_redefinition.circuitkit_role: exploratory localization only (EAP-IG / attention inspection); its numerical difference vs HF is measured and reported, not used as a gate
parity_redefinition.reason: v2 BF16 CircuitKIT/TransformerLens parity missed tolerance (max next-token logprob diff 0.149-0.252 vs 0.05) while argmax matched 12/12 (runs/aya-beam-20261107/sequential-evidence/parity.json).

wsp_agent.primary_programmer: gpt-6-astra (Codex), supplementary model; does not count as the submission model
wsp_agent.replication_programmer: a second frontier model under the identical harness
wsp_agent.forward_pass_definition: one try_edit or measurement call over at most 64 discovery prompts
wsp_agent.transcripts: every tool call and response logged

selection.guardrails: neutral and correct_suggestion within 0.02 of B on validation
selection.tie_break: fewer changed weights, then smaller update norm

controls.random_patch: same tensors, same number of changed slices, update norm matched
controls.shuffled_weight_agent_control: agent sees weight values permuted within each tensor; tests reading vs priors (arXiv 2611.08070)

regressions.report: counts, differences and paired intervals; no regression gate beyond reporting except neutral/correct noninferiority

freeze: freeze_candidate binds source, prompts, selected patch hash, dataset/review/regression hashes before final-evaluate; refreezing and repeated final looks rejected
label_review: single-author executable oracles; blinded packet dist/wsp-final-label-review for an independent reviewer; LLM cross-check by a different provider is supplementary, never ground truth
